meta_title: VPN Split Tunneling by IP Address and IPv6 | VpnHood!
meta_description: Decide which IP addresses use the VPN, at device level or inside the app, and what happens to IPv6. In the VpnHood! apps.
title: Split tunneling by IP address
lead: Decide which IP addresses use the VPN, on the device or inside the app, and what happens to IPv6.
shot_alt: The Split tunneling by IP address screen in the VpnHood! app
platforms: Android, Android TV, iOS, Windows and Linux
how_desc: Split IPs Via Device chooses which addresses use the VPN at the device level. Split IPs Via App applies the rules inside the app instead, and can also block addresses. Split IPv6 decides what happens to IPv6 traffic when the server has no public IPv6 address.
when_desc: Network ranges rather than names: a corporate subnet, a NAS at home, a service that only publishes addresses.
cost_desc: Address lists are easy to get subtly wrong, and an excluded range is unprotected. Prefer domain or country rules when they can express the same thing.
